import sys
input = sys.stdin.read().split()
index = 0
T = int(input[index])
index += 1
results = []
for _ in range(T):
    R = int(input[index])
    G = int(input[index + 1])
    B = int(input[index + 2])
    M = int(input[index + 3])
    index += 4
    r = list(map(int, input[index:index + R]))
    index += R
    g = list(map(int, input[index:index + G]))
    index += G
    b = list(map(int, input[index:index + B]))
    index += B
    potions = sorted(r + g + b, reverse=True)
    for _ in range(M):
        potions[0] //= 2
        potions.sort(reverse=True)
    results.append(max(potions))
print('\n'.join(map(str, results)))
